$comment: Our own public endpoints that serve this package's version, for the release wave. release.yml opens a 'Wave vX.Y.Z' issue with one checklist line per entry; scripts/check-release-sync.mjs probes every entry daily and ticks the line. This repository is public, so the list holds only endpoints anyone can already see; every other surface of the release is tracked privately and is never named here (test/wave.test.ts enforces it). `kind`: auto or track (a probe proves it; manual is supported by the code but not used here). `fix` may use <version>.

consumers.name: docs site (llms-full.txt)
consumers.fix: merge the bump PR that mcp-version-watch.yml (in mnemoverse-docs) opens from branch bot/mcp-version-<version>, or, if the bot could not open it, open one by hand from that branch.

consumers.name: marketing site (server-card.json → the connector card)
consumers.fix: the marketing card redirects to the connector's live card (mnemoverse-marketing card-redirect PR); it serves <version> once the connector serves it: see the connector line. Before that redirect is deployed: merge a "chore(mcp): version stamps" PR in mnemoverse-marketing.

consumers.name: hosted connector (/health package.version)
consumers.fix: merge the pin bump in mnemoverse-mcp-remote (the Dependabot PR or the receiver's PR) and let Railway deploy it; the package field appears once step 4 PR 4 (observability) is deployed.
